tools.name: get_video_transcript
tools.description: Extract the spoken-word transcript from a video URL. Works even when the video has no captions (server-side speech recognition). Supports TikTok, X/Twitter, TED, Twitch VODs, podcast hosts and 1000+ other sites. Max video length: 30 minutes.

tools.name: list_supported_platforms
tools.description: List which video platforms are supported and current limits.
